Democratic Congressman Al Green vows to introduce articles of impeachment against Donald Trump, accusing the president of taking the United States into war with Iran without congressional approval. Speaking on the House floor, Green warns that failing to hold Trump accountable risks turning America into a country that elects kings rather than presidents. He challenges lawmakers who acknowledge impeachable conduct but refuse to act, declaring that history will judge them.
